title: Warranty Administrator
salary_note: No salary given on the careers page — page must say 'Competitive salary'.
description_text:
Join our esteemed client in the automotive industry as a Warranty Administrator! If you're a proactive and detail-oriented professional looking for a dynamic and rewarding role, this opportunity is for you! 
 The Warranty Administrator performs a wide range of administrative and office support duties associated with vehicle warranties.
 Tasks: 
 Process warranty paperwork and ensure documentation is up to date as required by the manufacturer
 Insert correct warranty data in manufacturer systems, making sure every hour and material cost is claimed and recovered
 Ensure that all warranty exchanged parts are adequately stored in line with manufacturers policy
 Review warranty claims, correct any errors, and liaise with manufacturer when in doubt
 Give advice to the workshop on cases of recall and warranty as required and as stipulated by the manufacturer
 Ensure correct renditions of warranty claims with franchise and applicable reporting on defective parts
 Maintain good working relationships with the aftersales and parts departments
 Ensure that customer satisfaction is prioritised with regards to recall campaigns and that these are performed within stipulated time frames
 To be present and provide documentation to auditors during manufacturer audits.
 Keep abreast with all warranty updates, factory recalls and any other manufacturer announcements
 Reconcile all warranty receivables and work with accounts to obtain payments
 Liaise with the Assistant Manager to ensure the technical implementation of recall campaigns
 Handle rejected claims according to dealership and/or manufacturer specifications and follow up on outstanding claims
 Ensure adequate liaison with the body/paint shop where this is involved in warranty work and recall campaigns
 Maintain all service and customer records as required by the warrantor
 Attend any required training, (locally and abroad) organised by the company
 Carry out any additional duties assigned by the Aftersales Manager
 Adhere strictly to health and safety regulations and company policies together with franchise standard requirements
 Skills: 
 Active Listening
 Reading Comprehension
 Speaking
 Qualifications and Experience: 
 Olevel standard of education
 ECDL and good working knowledge of web-based applications
 Previous experience in warranty claims will be considered an asset
 Benefits: 
 Health Insurance
 Loyalty Card
 Specialized Training Locally or Abroad
 If you're eager to grow in a dynamic industry and contribute your skills to a thriving team, wed love to hear from you! Apply today and take the first step toward an exciting new opportunity.
